eligibility_text: Unorganised-sector workers aged 18-40 (street vendors, domestic workers, construction labourers, rickshaw pullers, etc.) earning Rs 15,000/month or less, not enrolled in EPFO/ESIC/NPS, and not an income-tax payer.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs 3,000/month after age 60. Subscriber contributes Rs 55-200/month (by entry age); the Central Government matches it equally. On death, spouse gets 50% as family pension.
source_note: Verified Sep 2026 via PIB and india.gov.in.
